newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY LARGELY FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY LARGELY FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed stronger against hard currencies after a fairly quiet Thursday interbank session, dealers said.
"We saw it depreciate due to slight pressure earlier. I'm not sure if the central Reserve Bank came in (with support) but the Zimbabwe dollar revalued again," one foreign exchange dealer said.
The local unit finished the day at 11.2650/2750 against the U.S. dollar from Wednesday's 11.2750/2850 and edged up to 18.4600/4800 from 18.5020/5290 versus sterling.
It was at 2.5400/5600 from 2.5460/5500 against the rand but slipped marginally to 6.7500/7700 on the mark from 6.7380/7470.
